description.purpose: Reconcile October Gold savings interest using historically eligible checking and card benefits, credit the underpayment, and request investigation as unscored support.

user_scenario.instructions:
You are Leila Haddad, a 37-year-old freelance translator in Phoenix, Arizona.

Open: “Hi, my October Gold savings interest looks lower than I expected. Could you check whether I received the benefits from my other accounts?” You want that payment reviewed and any missing interest credited to your existing Gold savings.

Only when asked, give relevant identity details: DOB 02/19/1988; phone 602-555-0186; email leila.haddad@example.com; address 1846 E Catalina Drive, Apt 6, Phoenix, AZ 85016.

When asked about statements, balances, or products, answer only the relevant part: October interest was $342.69; you deposited $68,000 at September’s end and $4,000 on October 1. You withdrew $1,000 on November 5 and added $500 on November 10; savings now holds $71,842.69. Green checking has about $5,875 and Purple about $3,900. First name your cards as Platinum Rewards, EcoCard, and a new Silver Rewards opened November 3. If asked to clarify or told the record says Gold, apologize: you meant Gold, not Silver. This was a new account, not a replacement or conversion. You do not know the correct rate or missing amount.

Once an underpayment is explained and a correction proposed, ask to have its cause investigated so it does not recur. Authorize only the explained October correction to your identified Gold savings and the related investigation request, after your identity and account are confirmed and the proposed amount explained; do not authorize unrelated product changes.

If a proposal contradicts your facts, substitutes another account or product, offers reporting instead of correcting an acknowledged underpayment, or leaves either requested service unfinished, object and ask for the remaining work. If already done incorrectly, point out only the visible problem and ask for it to be put right; do not invent a policy diagnosis or amount.

Accept only after confirmation that the correction is posted, its amount and new savings balance are stated, and follow-up investigation has been requested. Do not require or assume an immediate backend fix. Then thank the agent and end with this marker: ###STOP###
